request.project_task: Build a travel expense submission and approval workflow.
request.project_goal: Reduce manual checking of employee expense claims.
request.project_description: An employee submits receipts; a manager reviews policy exceptions and finance reimburses approved claims.

functional_requirements.text: An employee creates an expense claim with trip details.

atoms.text: An employee creates an expense claim with trip details.

functional_requirements.text: The employee attaches receipts to expense items.

atoms.text: The employee attaches receipts to expense items.

functional_requirements.text: The system flags items above policy limits.

atoms.text: The system flags items above policy limits.

functional_requirements.text: A manager approves or rejects the claim.

atoms.text: A manager approves or rejects the claim.

functional_requirements.text: Finance records reimbursement for an approved claim.

atoms.text: Finance records reimbursement for an approved claim.

non_functional_requirements.text: Receipt files must be encrypted at rest.
All approval decisions must be auditable.

actors.name: Employee
actors.description: Submits travel expense claims with receipts.

actors.name: Manager
actors.description: Reviews and approves or rejects expense claims.

use_cases.name: Create Expense Claim
use_cases.goal: Employee creates an expense claim with trip details and attaches receipts.
use_cases.trigger: Employee decides to submit a travel expense claim.

success_postconditions.text: Expense claim is created with trip details and receipts attached.

steps.action: Employee initiates creation of a new expense claim.
Employee attaches receipts to expense items.
steps.expected_result: Receipts are attached to expense items.
Claim is saved and submitted for review.

user_stories.capability: create an expense claim with trip details
user_stories.benefit: I can request reimbursement for travel expenses.
I can provide proof of expenses.

system_stories.responsibility: Persist claim data and encrypted receipt files.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-001 — Create Expense Claim
Goal: Employee creates an expense claim with trip details and attaches receipts.
Primary actor: ACT-001
Trigger: Employee decides to submit a travel expense claim.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC001-001: Employee is authenticated.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC001-001] Employee initiates creation of a new expense claim.
  2. [STEP-UC001-002] Employee enters trip details.
  3. [STEP-UC001-003] Employee attaches receipts to expense items.
  4. [STEP-UC001-004] Employee submits the claim.
Source FRs: FR-001, FR-002

use_cases.name: Review and Approve Claim
use_cases.goal: Manager reviews flagged items and approves or rejects the claim.
use_cases.trigger: Employee submits a claim for review.

preconditions.text: A claim has been submitted and is pending review.

success_postconditions.text: Claim is approved or rejected with an auditable decision.

failure_postconditions.text: Claim remains pending or is returned for correction.

steps.expected_result: Claim details and flagged items are displayed.

steps.action: Manager reviews flagged items above policy limits.

steps.expected_result: Claim is approved and decision is recorded.
Claim is rejected and decision is recorded.

user_stories.capability: review flagged items and approve or reject a claim

system_stories.responsibility: Identify and mark expense items exceeding policy limits.

system_stories.system_action: Record approval decision with audit trail.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-002 — Review and Approve Claim
Goal: Manager reviews flagged items and approves or rejects the claim.
Primary actor: ACT-002
Trigger: Employee submits a claim for review.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC002-001: A claim has been submitted and is pending review.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC002-001] Manager opens the submitted claim.
  2. [STEP-UC002-002] Manager reviews flagged items above policy limits.
  3. [STEP-UC002-003] Manager approves the claim.
Alternative scenarios:
  - SCN-UC002-ALT-001: Manager rejects claim
Source FRs: FR-003, FR-004

use_cases.name: Record Reimbursement
use_cases.goal: Finance records reimbursement for an approved claim.
use_cases.trigger: A claim has been approved by a manager.

success_postconditions.text: Reimbursement is recorded for the approved claim.

steps.action: Finance records reimbursement for the claim.

user_stories.capability: record reimbursement for an approved claim
user_stories.benefit: I can process payment to the employee.

system_stories.responsibility: Persist reimbursement record for approved claim.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-003 — Record Reimbursement
Goal: Finance records reimbursement for an approved claim.
Primary actor: ACT-003
Trigger: A claim has been approved by a manager.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC003-001: Claim is approved.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC003-001] Finance opens the approved claim.
  2. [STEP-UC003-002] Finance records reimbursement for the claim.
Source FRs: FR-005
